svg.title: A Nested Renewal-to-Client Cohort
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-nested-renewal-account-funnel; chart type: funnel; title: A Nested Renewal-to-Client Cohort; subtitle: 400 researched employers narrow to 20 signed service accounts.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative annual cohort, not observed conversion performance. Each stage is a subset of the preceding stage; count unique employers once even when an account buys several services.; caption: The 5% end-to-end conversion is a planning assumption. Twenty signed accounts can support the illustrative Base revenue mix only when its lives, contracts, earning conditions, and full-year service periods also hold.; stages: label: Researched employers; value: 400 unique employer accounts; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Deduplicate public filing records by employer identity. Record the evidence date, broker relationship, likely renewal window, and a legitimate business contact channel.; label: Qualified renewal fits; value: 200 accounts; 50% of prior stage; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Confirm employer size, renewal timing, decision-maker access, and an identifiable PBM, stop-loss, or workers' comp problem; exclude accounts outside the desk's authority.; label: Completed discovery; value: 80 accounts; 40% of prior stage; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Hold documented discovery with the employer's authorized contact. Establish incumbent contract restrictions, available records, procurement timing, and the economic buyer.; label: Authorized diagnostic audits; value: 40 accounts; 50% of prior stage; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Obtain signed scope and secure access to necessary records. Complete a diagnostic with reproducible calculations before proposing contingent recovery or replacement coverage.; label: Signed service accounts; value: 20 accounts; 50% of prior stage; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Execute service terms and required compensation disclosures. These accounts overlap across revenue rails; signed status alone does not establish earned revenue or collected cash.

rect.title: label: Researched employers; value: 400 unique employer accounts; numeric value: 400.0; detail: Deduplicate public filing records by employer identity. Record the evidence date, broker relationship, likely renewal window, and a legitimate business contact channel.

label: Qualified renewal fits; value: 200 accounts; 50% of prior stage; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Confirm employer size, renewal timing, decision-maker access, and an identifiable PBM, stop-loss, or workers' comp problem; exclude accounts outside the desk's authority.

label: Completed discovery; value: 80 accounts; 40% of prior stage; numeric value: 80.0; detail: Hold documented discovery with the employer's authorized contact. Establish incumbent contract restrictions, available records, procurement timing, and the economic buyer.

label: Authorized diagnostic audits; value: 40 accounts; 50% of prior stage; numeric value: 40.0; detail: Obtain signed scope and secure access to necessary records. Complete a diagnostic with reproducible calculations before proposing contingent recovery or replacement coverage.

label: Signed service accounts; value: 20 accounts; 50% of prior stage; numeric value: 20.0; detail: Execute service terms and required compensation disclosures. These accounts overlap across revenue rails; signed status alone does not establish earned revenue or collected cash.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative annual cohort, not observed conversion performance. Each stage is a subset of the preceding stage; count unique employers once even when an account buys several services.
